newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EP says EU's immigration policies incite racism.
newsitem.headline: EP says EU's immigration policies incite racism.

text.p: Recent decisions on asylum and immigration taken by the European Union and EU national governments have exacerbated hostility towards non-EU citizens and asylum seekers, the European Parliament said on Thursday.
Euro-MPs adopted a resolution urging EU governments to square their policy on immigration and asylum with their commitment to step up action to combat racism, xenophobia and anti-semitism.
January 30 marks the start of the European Year Against Racism and a string of international, national and local initiatives to combat intolerance, discrimination and racist violence.

In a sideswipe at its extreme-right-wing members, which include French National Front leader Jean-Marie le Pen and six members of Joerge Haider's Austrian Freedom Party, the resolution "condemns vehemently" all racist statements and publications made by national and European politicians.
